formula: units[model,fuel,m] = VEH0160[model,fuel,Q] * VEH1153a[UK,Cars,Keepership=Total,fuel,m] / sum_{m in Q} VEH1153a[UK,Cars,Total,fuel,m]
inputs: df_VEH0160_UK.csv (BodyType=Cars, quarter columns); veh1153.ods sheet VEH1153a_RoadUsing (monthly, thousands with 3 decimals = units)
fallback: equal thirds when the fuel's quarter total is 0
checked: 2026 Q2: VEH0160 Cars 538,867 = VEH1153 Cars Apr+May+Jun 154,481+164,987+219,399 (exact); collector output sums 154,478 / 164,986 / 219,397 (rounding)
limits: Every model of a fuel type gets the national monthly profile of that fuel type. Model-specific timing (e.g. Tesla quarter-end deliveries, launches) is not captured: Tesla Model 3 2026-04 UK split 1,823 > plausible (validation share 1.11 in that month). Use the quarter row (month=2026-Q2) for exact UK checks.
